page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped directly to 2 physical cores, resulting in a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system and data storage. It also does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the dedicated CPU allocation and 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the instance offers a memory-optimized profile suitable for workloads requiring more memory per compute unit without the overhead of shared-core resource contention. It is appropriate for small-scale databases, caching layers, and memory-intensive enterprise applications that do not require local NVMe storage or high-density parallel processing.
